name: Yotta D1 / Yotta Greater Noida Data Center Park
notes: Yotta D1, the first of six planned buildings in the 20-acre Greater Noida Data Center Park (Tusiana, GB Nagar), was inaugurated by CM Yogi Adityanath on 2 Nov 2022 and is North India's first hyperscale data center; ~5,000 racks, 30 MW IT load (expandable to 50 MW), with park capacity cited at 160 MW (up to 250-350 MW across six buildings / 30,000 racks).

name: Yotta D2 & D3 (Greater Noida Data Center Park)
notes: Construction of Yotta D2 and D3 (30 MW IT load each) in the Greater Noida park was announced to start January 2022 with go-live targeted January 2024; trade coverage (Data Centre Magazine) describes D2 as a 60 MW AI facility planned to host 30,000 NVIDIA Blackwell B300 Ultra GPUs, part of a campus scalable to 250 MW.

name: Yotta D4-D6 (Greater Noida Data Center Park expansion)
notes: The Greater Noida park is planned for six data center buildings with ~30,000 racks; buildings D4-D6 remain in planning, with Yotta targeting total combined park capacity of 160 MW under a Rs 39,000 crore (~$4.7bn) multi-year investment program.

name: AdaniConneX Noida Data Center
notes: Adani Enterprises was allotted ~34,275 sq m in Noida (C Block, Phase 2, Sector 62) for a data center; AdaniConneX's Noida facility is under construction with ~100 MW IT load, RFS targeted around end-2024/2025, and has achieved TIA-942-B Rated 3 DCCC certification per the operator.

name: Sify Noida 02 hyperscale campus (Greater Noida)
notes: Sify's Noida 02 AI-ready hyperscale campus (Sector 132, Greater Noida) is designed for three towers with ~13,000+ racks and 78 MW IT capacity (some sources cite 130 MW power); CM Yogi inaugurated the first data center building in March 2025.

name: Sify Noida 01
notes: Sify's original Noida data center (established ~2012 as Noida's first commercial Rated-3 hyperscale facility) remains operational with capacity for ~2,100 racks; detailed IT-load capacity not published.

name: NTT Noida 1
developer: NTT DATA / NTT Global Data Centers
notes: NTT's original Noida data center at H223, Sector 63, Noida is operational (carrier-neutral colocation); capacity not published in accessible listings.

name: NTT Noida 2 campus
developer: NTT DATA / NTT Global Data Centers
notes: NTT's six-acre Noida 2 campus (data center corridor, Noida) is planned for 52.8 MW critical IT load across two data centers; the first building (~300,000 sq ft, launched 2024) is operational/being commissioned with Building B following.

name: STT GDC Noida 1 & Noida 2
developer: STT GDC India (ST Telemedia Global Data Centres)
notes: STT GDC operates two data centers in Noida (STT Noida 1, a purpose-built six-story facility with 48h fuel storage on a 5-acre plot, plus STT Noida 2); in 2023 STT GDC India signed an MoU with the UP government for ~Rs 4,100 crore investment in new Noida centers, describing Noida as an emerging hub.

name: Nxtra (Airtel) Noida I & II
notes: Airtel's Nxtra operates two Noida data centers: Noida I (Sector 62, ~1,200 racks) and Noida II (Sector 81, ~1,500 racks); both operational colocation facilities.

name: Nxtra (Airtel) Noida III
notes: Nxtra Noida III is planned as a ~450,000 sq ft hyperscale data center in the Noida/UP region capable of housing ~5,000 racks; status/construction timeline not confirmed in accessible sources.

name: CtrlS Noida DC1
notes: CtrlS operates its ~8 MW Noida data center (DC1), which draws ~60% of energy from an offsite solar farm per DCD; part of CtrlS's Noida footprint in GB Nagar district.

name: RailTel Silver Jubilee Data Center (Noida)
developer: RailTel Corporation of India / Techno Electric & Engineering (TECL)
notes: RailTel's 'Silver Jubilee' data center is under construction on a ~17,000 sq m plot in Noida Phase-2 with Techno Electric as managed-service partner; initial 5 MW expanding to 10 MW, launch targeted within ~18 months (announced 2025).

name: Web Werks Noida hyperscale data center
developer: Web Werks (now part of Iron Mountain Data Centers India)
notes: Web Werks announced plans for a 20 MW hyperscale data center in Noida (2022) and markets an operational Delhi NCR data center; current status of the Noida 20 MW project not confirmed in recent sources.

name: Techno Digital Noida DC
notes: Techno Digital is developing a phased, AI-focused hyperscale data center in Noida to serve GPU/AI workloads for corporate, hyperscale and government clients in NCR; capacity and timeline not published.

name: AM Green Greater Noida AI infrastructure campus
notes: AM Green (AMG) signed an MoU with Invest UP to develop a ~289-acre AI infrastructure hub in the Greater Noida (YEIDA) region, cited as a ~$25 billion project leveraging AMG's renewable/storage capabilities; site planned for 2028 with full completion targeted by 2030.

name: Reliance Jio planned data center campus (UP region)
notes: DCD reporting on Noida data center land allocation noted Reliance Jio is planning a ~200 MW data center campus in the UP region; exact site (Noida/Yamuna Expressway corridor) and timeline not confirmed in accessible sources.

name: SOLOIDC Noida DC
notes: SOLOIDC operates a Tier-3 carrier-neutral colocation data center at Netedge Towers, C 56/39, 5th Floor, Sector 62, Noida, serving managed hosting and multi-cloud workloads; capacity not published.
